description: This file implements WebSocket handling classes and functions for the cuttlefish project, including message queuing, data writing, and HTTP transaction management.

classes.name: WebSocketHandler
classes.description: Handles WebSocket communication, including message enqueueing, writing buffers, and managing connection state.

classes.name: DynHandler
classes.description: Handles dynamic HTTP data processing over WebSocket, including appending data and managing HTTP transaction completion.

methods.name: AppendData
methods.description: Appends data to a buffer, used internally for managing WebSocket data streams.

methods.name: EnqueueMessage
methods.description: Queues a message to be sent over the WebSocket, with support for binary and text data.

methods.name: WriteWsBuffer
methods.description: Writes the WebSocket buffer to the connection, handling partial writes and errors.

methods.name: OnWritable
methods.description: Handles the writable event, sending queued messages and managing connection closure.

methods.name: AppendDataOut
methods.description: Appends outgoing data to the buffer for transmission.

methods.name: AppendDataIn
methods.description: Appends incoming data to the buffer for processing.

methods.name: OnWritable
methods.description: Handles the writable event for the dynamic handler, sending data and completing HTTP transactions.

methods.name: content_len
methods.description: Returns the current content length of the outgoing buffer.
